signals.title: xAI Grok Voice Agent Builder (no-code phone agents)
signals.summary: No-code builder deploys a production phone agent in ~2 min, sub-second latency, single speech-to-speech path, SIP into existing numbers, ~$0.06/min all-in. Voice API expanded 21 voices Jul 7.
signals.run_with_it_note: Point it at a spare Twilio/DID number this week, feed it one business FAQ doc, let it answer the after-hours booking line for NPB or DCKT. ~$0.06/min, no build.

signals.title: Cactus Hybrid: on-device model that knows when it's wrong
signals.summary: Open-source confidence probes let a small local model (Gemma 4 E2B) score its own certainty and keep 45-85% of queries on-device, escalating only the hard ones to cloud. AUROC 0.814 vs 0.549 for token entropy.
signals.run_with_it_note: Run it on a phone/edge box against a real DCKT task (trip-time / tide Q&A). Measure what fraction stays local. Proves a private, offline-capable assistant is viable on ground he fully owns.

signals.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: cheap, fast real-time inference
signals.summary: Flash-Lite lands at $0.30/M input, $2.50/M output at 350 tokens/sec, with big jumps on coding and long-context. Cheap enough to run always-on agent loops.
signals.run_with_it_note: Swap it in as the brain behind a lightweight SMS/voice loop on his Twilio line for one business. Cost of a test run is pennies. Do it this week.

signals.title: Claude Opus 5 (fast mode + mid-conversation tool swaps)
signals.summary: New frontier model. Same price as 4.8 ($5/$25 per M), a 2.5x fast mode at 2x cost, and beta mid-conversation tool changes that don't break the prompt cache, plus better agentic verify-and-iterate.
signals.run_with_it_note: Capability David uses, not builds on. Worth adopting in existing agent skills; not a standalone thing to own.

signals.title: Screenpipe (YC S26): local screen/audio recording into agents
signals.summary: Open-source, local-first tool records everything you've seen/said/heard on-device and turns it into a searchable context layer agents act on. 100% local, opt-in PII redaction.
signals.run_with_it_note: Interesting pattern for capturing operator knowledge, but needs a build before it earns its keep.

signals.title: Distill + serve frontier-quality models at half the cost
signals.summary: OSS tooling to distill and serve models claiming frontier quality at roughly half the inference cost.
signals.run_with_it_note: Infra play, low operator fit. Track.

signals.title: Echo: open-weight model orchestration at 1/3 cost
signals.summary: Routes each request across open-weight models (GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.7) for Fable-level results at ~1/3 the cost. Proprietary cloud, closed routing, account required.
signals.run_with_it_note: Fails own-the-ground: closed cloud, proprietary routing is the product. Rented land, cannot be a Spark.

signals.title: Bloomy (YC S26): AI mastery learning for K-12
signals.summary: AI-powered mastery-based learning for K-12, active Launch HN discussion.
signals.run_with_it_note: Map of where seed money is going (education AI). No direct David fit.

signals.title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta warn against overregulating open-weight models
signals.summary: Big vendors publicly defend open-weight AI against regulation. Backdrop that the open-weight lane David can own stays open.

signals.title: Nubia (ZTE) first mass-produced AI-agent smartphone at WAIC
signals.summary: First mass-produced phone that acts as a personal AI agent, unveiled at WAIC Shanghai Jul 17-20. Desk-to-mobile ambient signal, but consumer hardware.
signals.run_with_it_note: Rented consumer hardware, nothing to build on. Watch the trend, not the device.

signals.title: Eric Lefkofsky (Tempus AI) climbing Wikipedia top articles
signals.summary: Tempus AI founder at #15 with ~120k views on Jul 24, ahead of the story landing. Health-AI money-mover attention spiking.
signals.run_with_it_note: Faint blip. Demand check not run (no KE key). Watch for the story behind the spike.
